facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A girl wore a red hood. Grandmother was sick. She took a basket. She walked alone.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Once upon a time, there was a girl called Red Riding Hood. Her grandmother was sick, so Mother packed a basket of food. She walked alone through the forest to visit Grandmother. The forest was quiet and a little bit dark. She was brave but also a little scared. She kept walking on the path all by herself.
